rationale: The description explains that Cribl collects, reduces, enriches, normalizes, and routes data, with automatic log discovery and metrics production; these are conventional observability-pipeline functions without an affirmative AI signal.
evidence_spans:
Cribl Stream is a vendor-agnostic observability pipeline that gives you the flexibility to collect, reduce, enrich, normalize, and route data from any source to any destination within your existing data infrastructure. You’ll finally achieve full control of your data stream, empowering you to choose how to treat your data to best support your business goals.

Cribl Edge provides the flexibility and control administrators love from Stream, now running at the edge. Combined with automatic log discovery and metrics production, Cribl Edge empowers developers and operations teams to discover relevant telemetry hidden in unknown and legacy applications that have limited tooling.
